$comment: One object per case; `skills` names what should load, `expected_behavior` lists what a passing run must do.

expected_behavior: reads the change with gh pr diff 42 and gh pr view 42
reports only findings anchored on added or modified lines
tags every finding with a conventional comment label and a blocking or non-blocking decoration
posts nothing on the PR

routing.query: Relis ce diff avant que je l'envoie, c'est un patch Mercurial
expected_behavior: reviews the pasted patch without asking for a git branch
writes the report in French and keeps the labels in English
lists what could not be verified

routing.query: Write the review comments for points 1 and 3, I'll paste them in Bitbucket
expected_behavior: writes one comment per point, each in a four-backtick raw Markdown block
starts each comment with a subject line like issue (blocking, errors): ...
puts any code fix in a fenced block tagged with its language

routing.query: Publie les commentaires 1, 2 et 4 sur la MR !318
expected_behavior: lists the three comments with their target and subject line before posting anything
waits for an explicit approval of that list
checks the MR head commit is still the one reviewed
creates them as draft notes, not published comments, and publishes only on a second go

routing.query: Review high de la PR #57 sur le dépôt open source d'un client, c'est une MR externe
expected_behavior: runs at level high and states Level: high · Scope: external in the header
passes high explicitly to /code-review when it is available
does not load the user's craft or language convention skills
still cites the project's own CLAUDE.md or CONTRIBUTING rules on the conventions axis

routing.query: Fais une review low de ma branche avant que je pousse
expected_behavior: reports blocking findings only
covers business fit, errors, security and tests of the changed behaviour
